// Assessment-only actual-handler responses. No listener or evidence-file reads.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"

	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/apps/gallery"
	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/internal/qualityplan"
)

type response struct { Status int; Headers map[string][]string; Body string }

func main() {
	plan, err := qualityplan.Default(); if err != nil { panic(err) }
	all, err := plan.List("", "all"); if err != nil { panic(err) }
	h := gallery.New(); out := map[string]response{}
	capture := func(path string) {
		r := httptest.NewRecorder(); h.ServeHTTP(r, httptest.NewRequest("GET", "http://127.0.0.1"+path, nil))
		if r.Code != 200 { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d", path, r.Code)) }
		out[path] = response{r.Code, r.Header(), r.Body.String()}
	}
	for _, theme := range []string{"light", "dark"} {
		for _, scope := range []string{"core", "on-demand", "all"} {
			for _, capability := range []string{"", "analytics.comparison"} {
				q := url.Values{"theme":{theme}, "scope":{scope}}
				if capability != "" { q.Set("capability_id", capability) }
				capture("/quality?"+q.Encode()); capture("/api/quality?"+q.Encode())
			}
		}
		for _, item := range all.Items {
			q := url.Values{"theme":{theme}, "scope":{"all"}, "expected_revision":{all.Revision}}
			capture("/quality/"+item.ID+"?"+q.Encode()); capture("/api/quality/"+item.ID+"?"+q.Encode())
		}
		capture("/catalog/analytics.comparison?theme="+theme)
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(out); err != nil { panic(err) }
}
